name: Fearfully And Wonderfully Made
overview: Scripture reveals that humanity is uniquely created by God in His own image, formed intentionally from the dust and given life by His breath (Genesis 1:27; 2:7). The Psalmist affirms God's intimate knowledge and care from the womb, declaring that we are fearfully and wonderfully made, a testimony to God's marvelous works (Psalms 139:1, 13-14). Additionally, children are described as a precious heritage and reward from the Lord, underscoring the sacredness of human life as established by divine design (Psalms 127:3).
